_description: Domain randomisation of the simulator's UNCERTAIN numbers (tools/nn/train/dr.py; training only, OFF unless run.py --dr). Each battle draws, once at its start, a value of every knob below inside [lo, hi]: half the battles below the centre (uniform in [lo, centre]), half above (uniform in [centre, hi]), so the centre - the number config/nn/sim.json holds - stays the median and no number moves. A scalar knob's centre is read from sim.json (tools/nn/sim/knobs.py SCALARS); a *_scale knob multiplies a table (centre 1). A per-unit knob ('field') changes that field of every unit whose value is a listed centre: by_value [centre, lo, hi], one draw per entry and battle. The same value for both sides (a property of the game, not of a side). Ranges come from the evidence named in each 'why' (the spread of the measurements, a confidence interval, the disagreement of sources, or an honest estimate); numbers straight from the game's database get none. Damage, speed and leadership already have their own spread (tools/nn/train/randomise.py, +-15 % +-5 % a side): numbers whose error only scales the melee or missile damage are left to it. 'off': true leaves a knob out. Described in docs/*/training/training.md (after 'Domain randomisation').

front_fill_ranks.why: melee.front_fill_why: the dmgmelee probe's fit lam 1.46, 90 % lane bootstrap 1.17-1.92 (taken as 1.5); whole battles still show the twin's worn units striking 1.15-1.56x the game at 1.5-4 men a file.

wave_amp.why: melee.wave_why: amp 1.48 fitted to the men in reach a second (132 lane-windows), rms 0.28 of the per-second medians - taken as +-0.28; no interval of the fit itself (an estimate).

hold_rate.why: contact.why / fresh_why: the melee probe's held formations 0.49-0.52 of the rule (6 lanes); the halt lanes of the fresh and meleeorders probes 0.69-0.73 of the control; whole battles: held units kill 0.08 men/s in the game against the twin's 0.21 at 0.5 (OPEN) - the sources disagree in both directions.

pursuit_rate.why: contact.pursuit_why: a router loses 0.64 (95 % CI 0.56-0.75) of a standing target's loss; the refit maps rate 0.35 -> 0.55 and 0.65 -> 0.90 linearly, so the CI's ends are 0.36 and 0.52.

leave_taken_melee.why: contact.pin_why: a leaving melee unit takes x1.23 (95 % CI 0.99-1.53, 855 episodes) of what an attacking one takes; 1.25 kept.

pin_s.why: contact.pin_why: 0 - the network's shooters told to move in melee (72 gate battles, 1,124 orders) were already 1.5-2.8 m off at 1 s, the wavemiss2 probe's 0.6-5.4 m (4 lanes); up to 1 s of hold is inside the 1 s sampling and the probe's slower start (an estimate).

pin_melee_s.why: contact.pin_why: the fatleave probe's leaver gained 1.5 / 4.6 / 9.3 m at 2 / 4 / 6 s; the twin at 1.5 s 0 / 4.9 / 10.8, at 2 s 0 / 3.4 / 9.3, at 2.5 s 0 / 2.0 / 7.8 - '2 s is the nearest, no outcome fitted'; 1.5-2.5 bracket the game's trajectory.

lord_max_attackers.why: contact.core_why: refitted 6.5 (General v clanrat spearmen -6 %, Warlord v spearmen +24 %); 5.5 gives -20 / +5 % - the two lords pull opposite ways, one step each side.

lord_splash_struck.why: contact.core_why: measured 2.07 over 506 blows, 1.84-2.30 over the 13 layouts of the lord-in-a-crowd probe.

min_runup_m.why: charge.why: 'a minimal run, only to play the animation' (no number in the game); the game's lords re-entering after < 20 m show no charge burst, after >= 20 m 1.25x (build/cyclecharge) - only the upper side has evidence: half the battles keep 10 m, half draw 10-20 m.

strong_ratio.why: morale.strong_enemy_why: the threshold lies between 1.5 (no effect at 1.2-1.5x) and 3.0 (effect at 3.0x); 3 is the smallest ratio that showed it; the recordings show the label at a median 1.9x (several enemies summed) - half the battles keep 3, half draw 1.5-3.

combat_ratio_scale.why: morale.combat_why: the winning thresholds 1.5 / 2.5 / 4 are FITTED (the database gives only the points; the community: thresholds unknown); 'winning from 1 changed nothing in the replay' - an estimate of +-25 % (log-symmetric).

rally_hazard_scale.why: morale.rally_hazard_why: the pooled table's bins differ by side up to -12 / +11 % (beyond 150 m: ours 22.0 %, the AI's 17.9 %, pooled 19.8 %; 110-125 m 16.8 / 18.7 / 17.4 %); the replay rallies 0.53 a unit against the game's 0.60 (-12 %), mechanism OPEN.

multi_combat.why: fatigue.calibration.why: 13.7 a tick matches the 0-80 s mean; formations under an attack order gain ~110-120 points/s for the first ~50 s, then ~210/s (cause OPEN); the class fit's bootstrap 13.6-14.5 - lower end the early rate (11), upper an estimate of the same width.

sk_cone_deg.why: skirmish.why: the run ended when the enemy's way turned 28-53 deg off the line to the shooter (median 40 deg, 10 run ends); +-7 deg ~ the median's uncertainty from 10 values.

sk_other_end_per_s.why: skirmish.why: 0.18 a second; the probe's 'pass' runs lasted 5-7.5 s (0.13-0.20 a second), the recordings 338 ends in 1554 s (0.22 a second raw).

sk_new_point_m.why: skirmish.why: 5 m is the recordings' 'same point' bound, not a fit and not a game number (the game's rule for which order erases a run is not known) - an estimate.

aim_s.why: missile.why / aim_s_musket_why, docs training/measurements.md: the first shot after halting, archers 3.3 s (3-4), slingers 4.3 s (4-5), musket category 1.5-2.5 s (1 s samples); also the re-aim after a broken target (reaim_broken).

quiet_s.why: missile.order_quiet_why: after a new order the crossbows' first shot 6-9 s (median 7.5), their volley of 80-94 % of the men 7.5-9 s; a 7.5 s window was tried and fitted the twin worse - so 8.0-9.0.

broken_at.why: missile.reaim_broken_why: '~1/3' - the volleys split after the crossbows' 3rd-4th volley and the archers' 2nd-3rd; the threshold's mechanism is OPEN (an estimate).

friendly_fire.why: missile.why: arrows 0.26 (1.5k seconds of 18 battles), slings 0.56 (1.3k seconds of 10 battles), a regression with no interval kept; the same kind of measure (spill_melee) differed x0.5-x2 between data sets - taken x0.7-x1.4 (an estimate). The musket's 0.08 is a direct probe (meleefire: 0.07-0.08): no range.

sk_m.why: skirmish.why: the start gap, Empire 43.9 m (median of 18 lanes, 38.8-48.5), Skaven 33.1 m (median of 10, 30.4-37.1); OPEN whether it depends on the shooter or on the chaser (they go together in the probes), the militia not measured.

sk_stop_m.why: skirmish.why: where the runs that got away stopped, 73-95 m (6 lanes: Empire 80-95, Night Runners 73-77).
